subject: 巩县石窟第一窟 · 中心柱主像与胁侍
author: Windmemories
source_note: 以同一摄影者同日两张第一窟实拍定位同一造像组。只画中心柱一面可见主像和两胁侍；省略邻壁千佛与密集背景，不将线稿作为文物修复复原依据。
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single fine-line architectural illustration for the Chinese heritage collection 访古.
Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER, an existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing. Match its elegant, delicate, slightly organic thin lines, restrained detail, generous blank areas, and consistent visual density. Image 2 (and subsequent photos if applicable) is SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY: draw the actual named monument in that reference, preserving its identifying silhouette, roof type, visible storey count, bay count, openings, and proportions.
Create a refined, sparse BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE line drawing. Use confident fine contours with a few finer internal structural lines. All surfaces remain WHITE; use outlines for doors and windows rather than dark fills. No solid shadows, no broad grey shading, no crosshatching, no pencil grain, no texture, no gradient. No color, no gold, no black background. The white will become transparent and the ink the relevant dynasty color in the website.
Show the complete monument, centered, approximately straight-on at facade level, with verticals vertical and minimal perspective. Use only a few short ground lines. Remove tourists, foliage, vehicles, wires, modern signage, fences obstructing the structure, neighboring distractions and sky. Preserve architectural ornament selectively, without filling every roof tile or brick. No invented features. No labels, letters, calligraphy, dimension lines, captions, watermark, frame or border.
Wide compositions: landscape 1536×1024, entire building occupies about 82% of canvas width, roof/apex and base uncut, balanced breathing room. Tall pagodas: portrait 1024×1536, entire pagoda occupies about 82% of height, centred with equal side margins, apex and base uncut.


SUBJECT-SPECIFIC INSTRUCTIONS:
Draw the actual central seated Buddha with its two smaller standing attendants on ONE face of the centre pillar in Cave 1 of Gongxian Grottoes, Henan, Northern Wei period. The subject in photo 2 is the identifying geometry; photo 3 gives a little wider context of this SAME sculpture group, not additional figures to include. Render the complete visible three-figure niche as a single sparse black contour plate, with the Buddha centrally seated cross-legged on its draped rectangular pedestal, the surviving upraised forearm stumps/hand damage left exactly as seen, two attendants one on either side, the large worn halo behind the Buddha. Preserve the actual Northern Wei narrow elongated face, slim body, long drapery and distinct sharp robe hems; do not borrow the style-master Buddha physical shape or replace its face. Preserve damaged missing areas as simple contours, do not invent restored hands. Show minimal stone niche boundaries and pedestal, only the visible composition. Eliminate the hundreds of tiny background Buddhas, relief panels on neighboring walls, cave darkness and photographic texture. The image should have only major facial outlines and 8–12 garment folds, like the style master, not engraved dense rubbing texture. Landscape 1536x1024, whole visible niche isolated centered with ample pure white margin, no solid shadows, hatch marks, text or decorative background.

historical_sources.title: 故宫博物院：巩县石窟第一窟
historical_sources.supports: 第一窟方形中心柱结构及帷幔、千佛、帝后礼佛图。

site_recommendation.name: 巩县石窟
site_recommendation.sub: 第一窟 · 中心柱造像
site_recommendation.yearNote: 520仅作北魏晚期造像阶段的近似排序点，不视为窟龛确切题记年。
site_recommendation.place: 河南 · 巩义 · 河洛镇寺湾村
site_recommendation.lede: 巩县石窟的中心柱把礼佛路径环绕起来。第一窟中，主像与胁侍从石壁中凸出，垂衣、背光和安静的面相保存着北魏晚期造像的形迹。

facts.label: 开凿
facts.text: 石窟始建于北魏时期，东魏、西魏、北齐、唐、宋等代续有营造。

facts.label: 窟室
facts.text: 第一窟为方形中心柱窟，柱面开龛，四壁分布千佛与礼佛浮雕。

facts.label: 图像
facts.text: 第一窟保存帝后礼佛浮雕；本图取中心柱一面主像及两侧胁侍，未把邻壁浮雕混入构图。
